baseline_construction.representation: a reproducible representation of the evidenced iteration-1 request, regenerated by the real construction path (the loop's package construction over the record truncated at the activation event; the adapter's prompt rendering; the transport's request construction) and verified against the record's own LOOP_ITERATION commitments. The one field no artifact records — the package bounds' seconds_remaining, a live countdown at construction — stands as the full pinned deadline, the value at the activation instant, the doorway's clock standing at the stored activation anchor while the real derivation ran.

catalogue_source.catalogue: the worker-facing tool catalogue the loop derives from the sealed ASSEMBLY_GENERATED grants (framework.loop._derive_catalogue), as carried in the regenerated package's tools field
catalogue_source.derivation: framework.adapter.OpenAICompatibleAdapter._native_tool_definitions over the catalogue entries for the offered tools — the adapter's own per-grant native derivation

tool_choice.baseline: absent — no tool_choice field stands in the request; with no tools offered, the provider names this configuration tool choice none
tool_choice.modified: absent — the field is omitted, leaving the provider's natural (automatic) tool choice
